summary:
Results inbox worked per RBC-INBOX-01, RBC-LAB-03 and RBC-RAD-05. 12 of 13 items are closed; 1 stays open on purpose.

FIRST 8 ITEMS
- pt-0006 Raj Patel, CT urogram 10/19: nothing found to explain the hematuria. It showed the 4 mm LLL nodule that lung screening already follows. I first ordered the next yearly screening low-dose CT (sr-t0001), plus a tracking task, a patient message and a note. A later addendum replaced this plan (see below).
- pt-0016 TSH: normal; closed.
- pt-0016 potassium 6.3: the lab corrected it to 4.4 (analyzer fault). I acted on 4.4, so no action; closed.
- pt-0007 Leslie Parisian, preliminary CT angiogram of the chest: the final report (dr-00084) says the "nodule" is a blood vessel and no follow-up is needed. Closed with that comment.
- pt-0007 BMP 10/22: kidney injury (creatinine 1.64, up from 0.98 about 35 h earlier). Ordered an urgent repeat BMP by Mon 10/26 (sr-t0009), messaged the patient, wrote a note, closed.
- pt-0064 St. Brigid BMP from 9/26 (creatinine 1.36): no earlier value in the comparison window, so not kidney injury; closed.
- pt-0033 BMP 10/22 (creatinine 1.31): the 10/21 value of 0.84 was entered in error and I left it out. Not kidney injury against 1.27 on 10/17; closed.
- pt-0008 Walter Brennan, potassium 6.4 flagged hemolyzed: I followed the hemolyzed-sample rule — urgent repeat BMP (sr-t0015), patient message, note, no on-call notice.

ITEMS THAT ARRIVED WHILE I WORKED
- pt-0008: the lab corrected the result. The sample was not hemolyzed, so 6.4 is real. I switched to the critical-potassium rule:
  - stat on-call notice (comm-t0020) and a stat BMP for today (sr-t0019), replacing sr-t0015;
  - corrected patient message telling him to come in today (comm-t0021);
  - medication review: no potassium-raising drug that is safe to hold. Metoprolol was kept because stopping it suddenly is unsafe with his heart disease.
  - Note doc-t0022.
- pt-0006: Lakeshore added an addendum to his 4/14 screening scan: a new 5 mm RUL nodule, Lung-RADS 3, repeat scan in 6 months. Timed from 4/14, that window runs 9/14–11/14 and is still open. Ordered a screening low-dose CT for 10/23–11/14 (sr-t0032), a tracking task due 11/14 (task-t0033), a corrected patient message and a note.
- pt-0033: new St. Brigid creatinine 1.78, 9 h after 1.31, which is kidney injury. Urgent repeat BMP by 10/26 (sr-t0024), patient message, note, closed.
- pt-0064: new creatinine 1.48 vs 0.88 about 35 h earlier, which is kidney injury. Urgent repeat BMP by 10/26 (sr-t0025), patient message, note, closed.

STILL OPEN: inbox-a0002, pt-0007 chest X-ray from 10/22. Only a preliminary resident read exists ("possible 7 mm RUL opacity; consider CT"). No final report has been issued, so I left it open.

NEEDS A STAFF MEMBER (my tools can't cancel these):
- pt-0008: urgent BMP order sr-t0015 is replaced by the stat order sr-t0019.
- pt-0006: yearly scan order sr-t0001 and its tracking task task-t0002 are replaced by sr-t0032 and task-t0033.
Please cancel both sets; the replacement is documented in each patient's note.

Your messages queue (6 refill requests) is not part of the results inbox and was not worked.
